answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the vault queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The umber index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 146 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the comet. Honest users pay that once, farms 39 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
